title: The preferences UI carries one section per operator-elicited category with a labelled silence toggle and one section per sibling channel with a digest opt-in
asA: operator of a shipped rcf-lite application
iWant: a preferences surface where I can silence notification categories I no longer want and opt into a digest on a sibling channel that is applied
soThat: I control my own notification fatigue without asking an admin to turn a category off system-wide

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given the preferences route, the surface renders one section per operator-elicited category (each section carries a `[data-preference-section="category"]` wrapper) with a labelled silence toggle whose control element carries `[data-preference-category="<category>"]` and whose accessible name reads `"Silence <category> notifications"`. Activating a silence toggle records the preference at `POST /api/preferences/category` (visible on `window.__notificationFetches`); the server responds and the toggle's `data-silenced` reads `true`.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the preference is recorded and reflected on the DOM

acceptanceCriteria.description: Given a preferences surface on a project that has NOT applied any `application-notifications-*` sibling channel blueprint, the digest opt-in section for each sibling channel renders with `[data-preference-status="sibling not applied"]` and the digest opt-in control is disabled (`aria-disabled="true"`); a preferences surface that offers a digest without a corresponding sibling applied is a defect. The pack does not itself drive this (no sibling channels exist on the shelf today); the AC is a mechanism-reach gap the README names for a v1.1 minor bump when the first sibling ships.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a preferences surface on a project without a sibling channel applied
acceptanceCriteria.when: the digest opt-in section is read
acceptanceCriteria.then: the section is disabled and labelled as sibling not applied
